USAGE:
    sufi [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject -d ef
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject -d mongo --tiered
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject -d ef --solution-kind webapp

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    new        Creates a new Sufi Platform solution
    list       Lists available templates           
    help       Shows help information              
    version    Shows version information

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Creates a new Sufi Platform solution.

USAGE:
    sufi new [NAME] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject -d ef
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject -d mongo --tiered
    sufi new MyCompany.MyProject -d ef --solution-kind webapp

ARGUMENTS:
    [NAME]    Solution name (e.g., MyCompany.MyProject). When provided, skips   
              interactive wizard                                                

OPTIONS:
                                DEFAULT                                         
    -h, --help                             Prints help information              
    -v, --version                          Prints version information           
    -d, --database              mongo      Database provider: 'ef' or 'mongo'   
                                           (default: mongo)                     
        --tiered                           Use tiered architecture (separate    
                                           HttpApi.Host + AuthServer). Default: 
                                           layered (API + Auth in WebApp)       
        --solution-kind         layered    Solution type: webapp or layered.    
                                           Legacy alias: single                 
        --multi-tenancy                    Enable multi-tenancy (forces tenants 
                                           module)                              
        --ef-provider                      EF Core sub-provider: sqlserver,     
                                           postgresql, mysql, mariadb, sqlite   
        --connection-string                Database connection string           
    -o, --output                           Output directory (default: current   
                                           directory)                           
        --modules                          Additional module keys to include.   
                                           Production feature packs are included
                                        
[truncated]
